release_gate.limits: Ready means only that one explicit call exactly equals one member of a complete matching historical rehearsal set within the reviewer-declared age window. It is not approval, authorization, a signature, or permission to send. The caller may be a contract and need not be an available transaction origin. No current state, future inclusion, gas, fees, nonce, effects, ABI authenticity, authority, wallet, provider identity, or chain authenticity is established. Calls in the set are independent; no writes are simulated. Nothing is sent.

binding.limits: Bound means only that this explicit call and expected bytes match saved provider evidence at the exact reviewed historical block. It is not approval to transact. The sender may be a contract: this does not prove that anyone can originate the call. No nonce, gas, fees, access list, wallet wrapping, signatures, state effects, ABI meaning, balances, current state or future success are checked. Even a returned ABI false may be bound if those exact bytes were expected. Digests identify input content; they do not authenticate a provider or the chain. Nothing is sent. Contributor relay source is attribution only; upstream identity and independence are unverified.
